definitions: A bacteriological stain used to identify acid-fast organisms, particularly mycobacteria.
A differential staining procedure that distinguishes acid-fast bacteria from non-acid-fast bacteria.
examples: The lab technician prepared the Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Mycobacterium tuberculosis is identified using Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
The Ziehl-Neelsen stain is crucial for diagnosing tuberculosis.
